thread:
Priya (product): Heads up — a large financial customer asked for a prescriptive playbook: immutable audit evidence + per-tenant custody chain + BYOK escrow support. They want this as launch criteria.
Mike (eng): Can you clarify 'custody chain'? do they mean signed hashes per exported file or inline ledger entries?
Priya (product): They want tamper-evident evidence we can hand over to auditors: signed manifest + SHA256 of export + proof of key origin for BYOK. Basically: export package that proves integrity and key lineage.
Jia (security): We should split requirements: 1) audit-log immutability in-platform (WORM-like), 2) export packaging with signed manifest, 3) BYOK key attestation / escrow handshake.
Tariq (solutions): From customer side they need: time-bounded retention buckets, legal-hold bypass, and an auditor-friendly index (searchable list of events with offsets).
Mike (eng): Quick feasibility notes: signed manifests doable with our KMS sign API, but BYOK attestation requires integration with customer KMS or escrow service. Escrow increases legal overhead.
Priya (product): Proposed launch criteria for an MVP:
- In-platform append-only audit stream for 90 days (immutable markers)
- Export format = deterministic JSONL + manifest.json with SHA256 per file, signed by Redwood signing key
- Optional BYOK flag that includes customer key fingerprint and handshake metadata in manifest
- Simple legal-hold toggle per-tenant in Console
If all met, label "compliance-evidence-v1" and market to pilot customers.
Jia (security): Need acceptance criteria for each:
- Immutability: tamper test documented (steps to flip an event should fail and be detectable)
- Manifest signature: verifier script included that validates signature and file hashes
- BYOK: record of successful KMS handshake + proof-of-possession timestamped in manifest
Also require threat model doc for escrow.
Mike (eng): Implementation sketch:
```
export-package/
  records.jsonl   # deterministic ordered events
  manifest.json   # { files: [{name, sha256}], signed_by: "redwood-v1", byok: { fingerprint }}
  proof.sig       # signature over manifest.json
```
We can reuse existing signer service, but need an API extension to include `byok_metadata` and `custody_chain_id`.
Tariq (solutions): For audit readiness playbook we should include step-by-step: how to validate package, how to present chain-of-custody to auditor, sample script, and escalation contacts. Customers love runnable scripts.
Priya (product): Prioritization ask: is this a full product bet (Q3) or an enterprise pilot? Proposing pilot for 2 customers (finance + healthcare) to validate effort.
Mike (eng): Effort estimate (very rough):
- In-platform WORM markers and retention gating: 2 sprints
- Export formatting + signer integration: 1 sprint
- BYOK handshake + escrow ops design: 2-3 sprints (security and legal involvement)
- Console legal-hold toggle + export UX: 1 sprint
Total: ~6-7 sprints to full feature set. Pilot requires subset: WORM + export + manifest + verifier script => ~3 sprints.
Jia (security): Dependencies: legal sign-off for escrow, KMS compatibility matrix, e2e threat modeling. Also logging for key access events.
Tariq (solutions): Customer success plan: onboarding checklist (BYOK onboarding call, test export, auditor runbook), and a sample SOW for escrow if needed.
Priya (product): Action items:
- Mike: spin up tech spike for exporter + signer proof-of-concept (due EOD next Thu)
- Jia: draft threat model + BYOK attestation spec (due next Tue)
- Tariq: draft pilot onboarding checklist and sample verifier script (due next Fri)
- Priya: reach out to two pilot customers and confirm interest (ongoing)
ops-bot: Created ticket PROD-11234: "evidence-package MVP spike" assigned to Mike.
Mike (eng): A couple quick questions: what retention tiers do we lock into for MVP? 90 days vs 1 year has storage/cost implications.
Priya (product): MVP scope = 90 days in-platform immutable markers + export capability for longer retention (customers responsible for archival after export). We can add automated archival in later phases.
Jia (security): One more: for manifest signing we should include signer key rotation metadata and revocation list URL in manifest. Auditors will want that.
Priya (product): Good call. Add `signer_key_id` and `signer_key_rotation_log` to manifest schema.
Tariq (solutions): I'll include an example `verify.sh` snippet in the playbook. Customers can run locally to confirm package integrity.
Priya (product): OK team — if no objections I'll add this to the compliance roadmap under "Evidence & BYOK Pilot" and spin up the tickets. Please ack or raise concerns within 24h. :thumbsup:
Mike (eng): ack
Jia (security): ack
Tariq (solutions): ack
Priya (product): Thanks — closing thread for now, will post ticket links once created.
